title: Relevance-conditioned evidence debt under selective evidence access
dead_end_scope: The standalone paper problem/method object that replaces page-coverage quantity with an explicit relevance-conditioned 'evidence debt' or unresolved-information-gap state to decide whether a long-document agent should continue searching/reading before answering.

counter_explanation.statement: DocAtlas already makes unresolved, relevance-conditioned information gaps an explicit mutable control state rather than relying on page-coverage quantity. Its structured Note is n=(found,evidence,plan), where plan states remaining information gaps; subsequent Search consumes accumulated findings and may issue a new sub-question, and Selective Evidence Access explicitly allows reading pages from unresolved gaps recorded in memory. Thus the correct opposite principle discovered from the P06 coverage-count dead end is already a first-class current-source information-seeking mechanism, not a new standalone evidence-debt object.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Under the same observed question, read evidence, note state, and budget, a policy equipped with DocAtlas-style remaining-gap plan state plus mutable Search/Read can express the decision to continue evidence acquisition without any separate scalar/page-coverage evidence-debt variable. A standalone evidence-debt formulation has no residual unless two states that are equivalent under the full found/evidence/plan plus mutable-search information require different answer/continue decisions for reasons the current-source state cannot express.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Evidence sufficiency is relevance-conditioned, but relevance-conditioned unresolved information is already representable as mutable plan/search state. Novelty requires a residual beyond explicit remaining-gap state, not a renamed debt score.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: Search for matched selective-evidence states with the same question, read evidence, source-attributed findings, remaining-gap plan, mutable search state, and budget, but different counterfactual answer-change risk under additional evidence. Only if this same-information pair yields different optimal answer-versus-continue decisions does an answer-change-risk object survive beyond DocAtlas-style mutable information seeking.
counter_explanation.scope: DocAtlas arXiv:2608.07527, especially Sections 3.1-3.3: mutable Search state, Selective Evidence Access, and Note=(found,evidence,plan) where plan records remaining information gaps.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: Page-coverage quantity as the missing control state: the protocol-valid P06 run showed coverage metadata did not selectively identify answer-evidence gaps, and the original principle readjudication established a structural indistinguishability witness for coverage-only states.

Static lexical/dense retrieval quality as the full explanation: on the frozen 64 answerable MMLongBench-Doc units, BM25, MiniLM dense, and hybrid retrieval all left substantial complete-evidence gaps at top-6; even hybrid top-20 recovered only 31/47 original BM25-gap units completely. These diagnostics are supportive only and do not authorize the dead-end decision.

Answer-conditioned retrieval similarity as a distinct residual: on the frozen 20 answer-hypothesis units, question-only and question-plus-answer MiniLM top-6 both achieved 9/20 complete evidence coverage, so simple answer-conditioned semantic similarity did not create a new control object. This diagnostic is supportive only.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched states that are equivalent under DocAtlas-style found/evidence/plan, mutable search/index state, explored-page history, and budget, but have different counterfactual answer-change risk and different optimal answer-versus-continue actions; the residual must also survive generic value-of-information/active sequential testing under the same information.

scientific_interpretation.safe_claim: The P06 coverage-count realization failed because page quantity is not answer-evidence sufficiency. That opposite principle remains scientifically correct, but turning it into a standalone relevance-conditioned evidence-debt state is absorbed by DocAtlas's existing mutable information-gap planning and Search/Read loop. The dead-end is authorized by the current-source same-information reduction, not by negative exploratory screens.
do_not_say: active evidence acquisition cannot improve document agents
dense retrieval solves the original P06 gap
the exploratory BM25/MiniLM diagnostics are confirmatory evidence
scientific_interpretation.new_problem_seed: Can two document-agent states with the same explicit unresolved information gaps and mutable retrieval state nevertheless differ in whether unseen evidence can change the current answer, making answer-change risk a distinct decision object beyond information-seeking plans?
